title: Bottom Signals, AI Purge, Bitcoin Stands Alone
script_summary:
Bitcoin just sat still while everything else burned — and that silence is screaming.

A parallel channel connecting three macro lows across five years is printing one of the cleanest structural setups in Bitcoin's history. That's not pattern-matching — that's geometry. Eighty-five thousand is just the next number on the chart.
